propositions: The dev bootstrap targets (make install, make install-unlocked) must explicitly list the metrics extra so lizard, scc, and jscpd are consistently available in provisioned venvs independent of CI test rationales.

Non-Python analyzers scc (Go) and jscpd (Node) cannot be installed via Python extras and require documented brew/npm install steps in local-dev-env.md, marked as optional and degrading gracefully to Unavailable.
The metrics extra was already locked in uv.lock and pulled transitively by the dev extra; the Makefile change hardens intent without adding new dependencies or causing lock drift.
With scc and jscpd unavailable on PATH, rebar metrics, make lint, make typecheck, and the test suite all succeed with no hard failures, reporting Unavailable for affected metrics lenses instead.
